description: TLUSTY NLTE model atmosphere grids with SYNSPEC optical spectra, distributed at tlusty.oca.eu as per-composition vispec tar archives. Each tar is the upstream publishing unit and holds BOTH kinds of every atmosphere of its composition: kind 7 (detailed spectrum) and kind 17 (continuum) — one model's two data, always held together. The complete tar inventory below is live-verified (2026-10-18); the blueprint declares all 20 tars.

tar_inventory.verified: inventory pages fetched live 2026-10-18 (OS02-VIspec.html, BS06-VIspec.html); every archive HEAD-checked 200 (Gvispec.tar and BGvispec_v2.tar fully downloaded and inspected); sizes below are the pages' published sizes

bstar2006.members_per_tar: two files per atmosphere, both kinds
bstar2006.note: the BS06 page prints Z/Z_sun = 1/2 for both BL and BS; the paper's five values are 2, 1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 (S = 0.2) — the letters and archive names, which the code keys on, are unambiguous

member_facts: members are flat (no subdirectory), named {comp}{teff:05d}g{logg*100:03d}v{vmicro*10:02d}.vis.{7|17}.gz, and gzip-compressed inside the tar (verified on Gvispec.tar: 138 members, 69 + 69)

kind 7 = detailed spectrum (Gvispec.tar G27500g300v10: 198345 rows from 3000 Angstrom); kind 17 = continuum (1697 rows on its own coarser wavelength grid) — the two kinds are one model's two data but NOT row-aligned; stellarlib records the sibling per node and never fakes an aligned continuum
format_facts: two columns: wavelength [Angstrom, AIR in the optical] and Eddington flux H_lambda [erg/s/cm^2/Angstrom]
SYNSPEC native sampling ~0.03 Angstrom per point in the red optical (R ~ 2e5)
on-disk sets may drop the .gz suffix; a reader given such a path opens path + '.gz'
